content:
200 Returned the specified tag category was updated successfully.
RESPONSE SCHEMA:
application/json
string
The unique identifier (UUID) of the category.
string
The name of the category. The name must be unique within a Tenable
Vulnerability Management instance.
string
The description of the category.
string
An ISO timestamp indicating the date and time on which the category
was created, for example, 2018-12-31T13:51:17.243Z .
string
The name of the user who created the category.
string
An ISO timestamp indicating the date and time on which the category
was last updated, for example, 2018-12-31T13:51:17.243Z .
string
The name of the user who last updated the category.
boolean
Indicates whether the tags in this category are reserved (cannot be
updated). This is a read-only field set by the system.
— 400
Returned if Tenable Vulnerability Management encounters any of the following error conditions:
name —The name  value in the request message exceeds 127 characters.
description —The description  value in the request message exceeds 3,000 characters.
Your request message does not specify a value for the tag category name.
401 Returned if the API keys specified in your request are invalid.
RESPONSE SCHEMA:
application/json
uuid
name
description
created_at
created_by
updated_at
updated_by
reserved
integer
The HTTP status code of the error.
integer
The standard HTTP error name.
string
A brief message about the cause of the error.
— 403
Returned if you do not have sufficient permission to edit the tag category. You either need to be an
administrator or have edit permissions on all tag values within this category to have permission to
update the category.
— 404 Returned if the specified tag category was not found.
— 429
Returned if you attempt to send too many requests in a specific period of time. For more information,
see Rate Limiting.
500 Returned if an internal error occurred.
RESPONSE SCHEMA:
application/json
integer
The HTTP status code of the error.
integer
The standard HTTP error name.
string
A brief message about the cause of the error.
